task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First of all, you could, like, make an effort to travel south. After that, head east. After that, attempt to travel south. And then, make an effort to go to the east. Then, make an attempt to head north. After that, make an attempt to venture north. That done, lift the latchkey from the floor of the cookery. And once you've done that, you win!
